name: Telgea
description: Manage Telgea Enterprise user plans and Partner lines, provision eSIMs, suspend or restore service, and read usage and rates. Operations require the corresponding Enterprise or Partner permissions.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: API Key
credential_fields.description: Telgea API key from your organization Portal under Integrations > API keys. Permissions determine Enterprise and Partner API access.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List Telgea users with pagination and optional exact email or employee ID filters.

pageSize.description: Items per page, at most 50. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: create_user
tools.description: Create a Telgea end user. Reuse idempotency_key when retrying the same request.

idempotency_key.description: A value unique to this request, of 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters — a UUID is the usual choice. Retry with the same key within 24 hours and you get the original response back, even if it was a failure, and nothing is done twice. Send a new key whenever you change the request. Keys are private to your API key and organisation.

email.description: Email address of the new user. Unique within your organization.

teamId.description: Team to assign the user to. Omitted, the user joins the default team, Unassigned.

costCode.description: Cost center code for billing purposes

tools.name: list_user_plans
tools.description: List user plans through the Telgea Enterprise API.

pageSize.description: Items per page, at most 100. Defaults to 50.

orderBy.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to the order the plans were created in.

orderDirection.description: Sort direction. Only meaningful together with orderBy.

tools.name: create_user_plan
tools.description: Provision a billed plan and eSIM for a user through the Enterprise API. Poll get_user_plan for readiness.

idempotency_key.description: A value unique to this request, of 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters — a UUID is the usual choice. Retry with the same key within 24 hours and you get the original response back, even if it was a failure, and nothing is done twice. Send a new key whenever you change the request. Keys are private to your API key and organisation.

userId.description: UUID of an existing user to provision a plan for

countryCode.description: Two-character ISO country code for the user plan. Must be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g., "DK", "US", "GB") and available in your organization's list of supported markets. Case-insensitive. Invalid codes are rejected immediately. Contact support to enable additional countries.

additionalNumber.description: Set to `true` to give a user who already holds a number another one, billed at its own local rate. Without it, a user who holds a number gets a `409` and nothing is bought, so repeating a request cannot buy a second number. Your organization must have several numbers per person enabled. Send an `Idempotency-Key` with it, so a retry does not add a further number.

tools.name: get_user_plan
tools.description: Read an Enterprise user plan, including eSIM activation details when ready.

userId.description: UUID of the user whose plan this is.

tools.name: list_numbers
tools.description: List lines through the Telgea Partner API, filtered by number, ICCID, user, or state.

pageSize.description: Items per page, at most 100. Defaults to 50.

orderBy.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to the order the lines were created in. `state` is not sortable: it is derived per line, so sorting by it would resolve the state of every line in your organization before a page could be picked. Narrow by it instead.

orderDirection.description: Sort direction. Only meaningful together with orderBy.

msisdn.description: Only the line on this number, in E.164 format. Matched exactly.

iccid.description: Only the line whose eSIM has this ICCID. Matched exactly; a line with no SIM never matches.

userId.description: Only the lines this user holds.

state.description: Only lines in this state. Costs more than the other filters, since the state of each of your lines is resolved to answer it.

tools.name: create_number
tools.description: Provision a billed line and eSIM for a user through the Partner API. Poll get_number for readiness. Use the same idempotency_key for retries.

idempotency_key.description: A value unique to this request, of 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters — a UUID is the usual choice. Retry with the same key within 24 hours and you get the original response back, even if it was a failure, and nothing is done twice. Send a new key whenever you change the request. Keys are private to your API key and organisation.

userId.description: UUID of an existing user to obtain the line for

countryCode.description: Two-character ISO country code of the market the line belongs to. Must be a valid ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g., "DK", "US", "GB") and available in your organization's list of supported markets. Case-insensitive. Invalid codes are rejected immediately. Contact support to enable additional countries.

additionalNumber.description: Set to `true` to give a user who already holds a number another one, billed at its own local rate. Without it, a user who holds a number gets a `409` and nothing is bought, so repeating a request cannot buy a second number. Your organization must have several numbers per person enabled. Send an `Idempotency-Key` with it, so a retry does not add a further number.

tools.name: get_number
tools.description: Read a Partner line, its state, and eSIM activation code when ready.

tools.name: get_number_connection
tools.description: Read network connection status for a Telgea Partner line.

tools.name: suspend_number
tools.description: Suspend all traffic on a Partner line. Availability depends on the market.

idempotency_key.description: A value unique to this request, of 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters — a UUID is the usual choice. Retry with the same key within 24 hours and you get the original response back, even if it was a failure, and nothing is done twice. Send a new key whenever you change the request. Keys are private to your API key and organisation.

tools.name: resume_number
tools.description: Restore traffic on a suspended Partner line.

idempotency_key.description: A value unique to this request, of 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters — a UUID is the usual choice. Retry with the same key within 24 hours and you get the original response back, even if it was a failure, and nothing is done twice. Send a new key whenever you change the request. Keys are private to your API key and organisation.

tools.name: restrict_number_data
tools.description: Stop mobile data on a Partner line while keeping other line services available.

idempotency_key.description: A value unique to this request, of 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters — a UUID is the usual choice. Retry with the same key within 24 hours and you get the original response back, even if it was a failure, and nothing is done twice. Send a new key whenever you change the request. Keys are private to your API key and organisation.

reason.description: Free text kept with the change and shown to our support staff.

tools.name: restore_number_data
tools.description: Restore mobile data on a Partner line.

reason.description: Free text kept with the change.

tools.name: list_usage
tools.description: Read voice, SMS, and data usage records. The inclusive UTC date window may span at most 31 days.

startDate.description: Inclusive start of the usage window (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC).

endDate.description: Inclusive end of the usage window (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC). The window may span at most 31 days.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's nextCursor. Omit for the first page.

userId.description: Restrict to one end-user your organization owns. Omit for every user.

tools.name: list_data_pools
tools.description: List shared Telgea data pools and remaining allowances.

tools.name: list_data_pool_members
tools.description: List lines drawing from a shared Telgea data pool.

tools.name: list_rates
tools.description: Read pay-as-you-go retail rates for a market and usage type.

pageSize.description: Items per page, at most 250. Defaults to 50.

market.description: The home-plan market to price, as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. The provider is resolved internally.

type.description: The rate type to price: INTL_VOICE (per minute), INTL_SMS / INTL_MMS (per message), or ROAMING_DATA (per MB)

servingCountry.description: The country the subscriber is calling from, when it differs from the market (roaming). Defaults to the market, which prices calls placed at home. Ignored for ROAMING_DATA, which prices every visited country in one list.

direction.description: Which leg of a call or message to price: outbound — the subscriber calls or texts the destination — or inbound — someone in that country reaches the subscriber, which is chargeable while roaming. Defaults to outbound. Ignored for ROAMING_DATA.

asOfDate.description: The day to price (YYYY-MM-DD): the rates in effect then. Defaults to today, so a price scheduled to take effect later is never quoted early. The provider is the one serving the market today.

currency.description: The currency to show prices in: EUR, USD or GBP. Defaults to the currency your organization is billed in.
